hook.say: Football, wrestling and a pocket-sized Olympic hero. Five questions on Turkish sport. Number five is a record!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which Turkish club won the UEFA Cup in 2000?
questions.say: Which Turkish club won the UEFA Cup in 2000?
questions.fact: Galatasaray beat Arsenal on penalties in the final.
questions.sayAnswer: Galatasaray! They beat Arsenal on penalties in the final.

questions.q: What do wrestlers cover themselves in at Edirne's Kırkpınar festival?
questions.say: What do wrestlers cover themselves in at the Kirk-pinar festival in Eh-deer-neh?
questions.fact: Kırkpınar oil wrestling is on UNESCO's intangible heritage list.
questions.sayAnswer: Olive oil! Kirk-pinar oil wrestling is on UNESCO's intangible heritage list.

questions.q: Türkiye's "Sultans of the Net" are the women's national team in what?
questions.say: Turkey's Sultans of the Net are the women's national team in which sport?
questions.fact: They won their first European Championship in 2023.
questions.sayAnswer: Volleyball! They won their first European Championship in 2023.

questions.q: "Pocket Hercules" Naim Süleymanoğlu won 3 Olympic golds in which sport?
questions.say: Pocket Hercules, Na-eem Sue-lay-man-oh-loo, won 3 Olympic golds in which sport?
questions.fact: He won gold in 1988, 1992 and 1996, standing just 1.47 m tall.
questions.sayAnswer: Weightlifting! He won gold in 1988, 1992 and 1996, standing just 1 meter 47 tall.

questions.q: Hakan Şükür scored the fastest goal in World Cup history. How fast?
questions.say: Hakan Shoo-koor scored the fastest goal in World Cup history. How fast?
questions.fact: He scored against South Korea in 2002, when Türkiye finished third.
questions.sayAnswer: 11 seconds! He scored against South Korea in 2002, when Turkey finished third.
